title: Onigiri
description: Hand-pressed triangles of warm, lightly salted rice around grilled salmon or sour umeboshi, wrapped in crisp nori. Makes 8.
notes: Wrap the nori just before eating so it stays crisp. Tuna with mayonnaise is the convenience-store favourite filling.

ingredients.name: salted salmon
ingredients.note: or salmon fillet sprinkled with salt

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear, then soak it in the measured water.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on the lowest heat, then rest off the heat with the lid on.
steps.tip: Resting finishes the steaming. Lifting the lid early leaves a wet top and a scorched base.

steps.text: Grill the salted salmon until cooked, then flake it.
With wet hands rubbed with a little of the salt, take a handful of warm rice, press a hollow into it, add salmon or umeboshi, and close it. Press into a triangle with firm, even squeezes.
steps.tip: Three or four presses. Squeezing harder makes a dense rice cake.

steps.text: Wrap each with a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
